title: Channels pour into plans
description: ribbon width = accounts · channels on the left, the plans they land in on the right

props.name: data
props.description: Channel names and complete nonnegative allocations indexed by plan. Channels sort by their total; tone follows that rank. All cells must be available for a complete allocation. Measured-zero links retain topology without ribbons; no accounts are fabricated.

props.name: plans
props.description: Ordered plan names. Each channel supplies exactly one count per plan; repeated names remain distinct indexed nodes.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
